header: An overall score, then one row per criterion
lead: Each row has five segments, so type 4.5, not 90%. The overall score is typed, not averaged from the rows; say in the note how it was worked out.
note: For completion percentages, use Progress Bars. To show how many people gave each rating, use Distribution Bars.

metrics.title: A partial row
metrics.text: Four full segments and one half: fractions are drawn, not rounded.

metrics.title: Another row
metrics.text: Leave the value empty and all five segments stay empty.
